messages:
deploy-bot: Starting gradual rollout: runtime v3.1 (batching opt) -> 15% traffic to edge-pool C
deploy-bot: Quick smoke run scheduled: synthetic embed-heartbeat (10qps, 3m) -> https://ci.internal/smoke/1749801111
ai-monitor: Observability alert: synthetic 'embed-heartbeat' p95 jumped to 1.2s on edge-pool C
rina: Seeing the same in traces. A handful of requests during the spike show long tail in response time, but no increase in 5xx.
jordan: Any differences in kernel selection or batching thresholds for v3.1 vs v3.0?
sam: v3.1 enables dynamic micro-batching with a 50ms coalescing window on edge-pool C. No other infra changes.
rina: I replayed the failing trace: large latency occurs right after tokenization step, then waits ~800ms before the model starts generating.
ops-bot: infra metrics snapshot: no CPU OOMs, network p99 for KV calls on pool C = 320ms during spike window
jordan: Could micro-batching be waiting for more inflight requests and adding latency under low qps? That would explain the tail.
sam: Good call. Micro-batching can add tail latency if QPS is below the coalesce threshold. For canary we should ensure test load meets batching window expectations.
rina: For now, recommend two actions: 1) throttle the canary load to higher sustained qps to match production batching behavior, or 2) temporarily override coalesce window to 0 (disable micro-batching) on pool C.
jordan: I prefer option 2 for quicker safety — we revert batching behavior on pool C and keep rollout progressing.
deploy-bot: Executing action: override runtime.v3.1.coalesce_ms=0 on edge-pool C (initiated by jordan)
ai-monitor: Note: synthetic 'embed-heartbeat' p95 dropped back to 56ms within 70s after override
sam: Nice. That confirms micro-batching interaction. We should record as a rollout note and add a short checklist to the release notes: "v3.1 enables micro-batching; coordinate smoke qps or toggle coalesce when canary traffic is low."
rina: Filed ticket FINP-7012 to track adding a micro-batching aware smoke harness and an automatic canary qps augmenter. https://tracker/internal/FINP-7012
jordan: Decision: continue canary ramp to 40% with coalesce_ms=0 on pool C until FINP-7012 complete. If p95 > 300ms or errors > 0.5% for 5m, rollback to runtime v3.0.
sam: I'll prepare a quick rollback playbook and add the exact CLI commands to the release notes.
ops-bot: Scheduled change window lock: override expires in 20m (1749802311) unless extended.
rina: I'll monitor for 20m then hand to oncall. Also adding an explicit mention: "No customer-facing errors observed; latency tail due to micro-batching under low QPS."
jordan: Adding to release notes now and pinging #customer-impact if thresholds breach. Thanks team :rocket:
deploy-bot: Canary state: ramp paused -> override applied on edge-pool C. Action logged (by jordan)
